t: Majapahit was a Hindu-Buddhist kingdom in eastern Java that dominated the archipelago's sea lanes in the 14th century.
Rice from the Brantas valley and control of the spice trade funded fleets, temples and a network of tribute-paying vassals.
Civil war, Malacca's rise and Muslim coastal sultanates such as Demak eroded it; its court culture lived on in Bali.
dyk: Majapahit's founder Raden Wijaya used a Mongol army sent by Kublai Khan to defeat his rival, then turned on the invaders and drove them from Java.
ev: Jayakatwang of Kediri kills Kertanegara, ending the Singhasari kingdom
Raden Wijaya expels the Mongols and becomes Majapahit's first king
Forces directed by Gajah Mada subjugate Bali
Hayam Wuruk begins the reign that marks Majapahit's height
The Sundanese royal party is massacred at the Battle of Bubat
Mpu Prapanca completes the Nagarakretagama, describing the realm at its peak
The Regreg War between the western and eastern courts drains the kingdom
Demak conquers the last reduced Majapahit court, probably at Kediri
